Hi Kelly — thanks for the draft and the clear timeline. We've reviewed and have a few adjustments and clarifications that will make the MAP executable from our side. Summary below; I'll attach a revised MAP (v1.1) after we align on ownership.

Proposed clarifications / additions:
1) Canary approach: we recommend a "shadow-run" for 48–72 hours in the canary window to validate outputs and measure quality without affecting live traffic, then a 10% live-traffic ramp for 24 hours, then 100% if gates pass. This reduces blast radius and gives you a chance to validate downstream integrations.
2) Evaluation gates & owners:
   - Quality (accuracy/regression vs baseline prompts): Clinical QA (GrayMatter) + Redwood Eval lead (Marissa) — acceptance: no more than 3% regression on critical prompt set.
   - Latency: Platform SLO P95 <= 350ms for 1k tokens (Redwood infra team) — acceptance: sustained for 24h during 10% ramp.
   - Error rate: <0.5% (all) — Redwood infra + GrayMatter SRE to monitor.
3) Migration strategy: we propose a two-phase migration:
   - Phase A: Shadow-run (read-only) to validate tokenization and response formatting.
   - Phase B: Controlled traffic migration in two waves (10% then 100%) with automatic fallback to last-known-good model variant.
4) Training & ops handoff:
   - Two half-day workshops for ops + clinical QA (runbook walkthrough & evaluation playbook).
   - One week of office-hours support post-100% cutover.
5) Risk register: we'll add a short remediation playbook for the top 3 risks (data drift detection, latency spike, hallucination regression).

Proposed timeline (updated):
- Kickoff: May 4, 09:00 PST (30–45m) — calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234kickoff
- Shadow-run: May 11–12
- 10% ramp: May 13 (24h observation)
- Full migration target: May 17
- Training workshops: May 18–19

Next steps / action items:
- Marissa: finalize Eval acceptance test set and coordinate eval runs with GrayMatter clinical QA.
- Tessa: produce final runbook & playbook templates and share by May 6.
- Kelly: confirm procurement timeline and sign-off owner for QA acceptance.

I'll circulate MAP v1.1 by tomorrow with these changes highlighted. Please let me know if any of the acceptance thresholds are unrealistic for your teams.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
